Netflix Acquires 2030 World Cup Broadcast Rights in Spain

Netflix has secured the broadcast rights for the 2030 World Cup in Spain and Andorra. This marks Netflix's first time broadcasting a major men's international football tournament in Spain. Spain is a co-host of the 2030 World Cup.
